delta.vocabulary_note: Deltas describe what this window’s record showed across its compared halves (past tense); they evaluate the record and predict nothing. insufficient_extraction means the feeding field did not meet the evidence floor in this window — starved extraction or too little history; the signal’s *_basis counts (input/empty per half) distinguish which. identity.rotation_note: window truncated by credential rotation: this window is scoped to the presenting credential and does not join the identity’s other or prior credentials; history under a rotated credential is not included.
